intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Wichita, KS for 2026, and here is what he found: 43 family events, 12 of them free. The magic runs from November 8 (Santa's Wonderland at Cabela's) through January 2, 2027 (Illuminations at Botanica and Somewhere in Winter), with Passport to Santa (from November 12), Watson's Christmas Express (from November 28), the Merry & Bright Union Station Lighting Event (December 3) and the Family ArtVenture Holiday Open House at the Wichita Art Museum (December 5) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Wichita

  • 43 Christmas events for kids in Wichita and nearby towns such as Haysville, Maize, Goddard, Park City, Mulvane, Augusta, El Dorado, Winfield and Kingman
  • 12 free events, including Santa's Wonderland at Cabela's, the Merry & Bright Union Station Lighting Event & Toy Drive, Winter Wonderland at Naftzger Park, Somewhere in Winter, the Wichita Symphony's Spirit of the Holidays concert, the Wichita Art Museum Holiday Open House and free parades in Augusta, Winfield, Kingman and El Dorado
  • Meet Santa: Santa's Wonderland at Cabela's, Passport to Santa at Exploration Place, Breakfast with Santa at the Ninth Floor, Santa Brunch at Newport Grill, the Family ArtVenture at the Wichita Art Museum and free Santa photos at Somewhere in Winter
  • Parades and tree lightings: Merry & Bright Union Station Lighting Event (December 3) and Winter Wonderland at Naftzger Park (December 4), plus small-town parades and tree lightings in Augusta, Winfield, Kingman, Park City and Goddard
  • Trains: Watson's Christmas Express at O.J. Watson Park (November 28 to December 20) and a miniature train display at the Wichita Art Museum Holiday Open House (December 5)
  • Shows: three Nutcrackers (Metropolitan Ballet, Nutcracker Magical Christmas Ballet at the Orpheum and Ballet Wichita), the Wichita Children's Theatre's The Best Christmas Pageant Ever and Toyland, and Music Theatre Wichita's Christmas Show
  • Season: November 8 to January 2, 2027
  • Planning a day trip? Newton, Hesston, McPherson, Hutchinson and Towanda have their own pages with more Christmas events for kids
